description:
Add a named-slot mechanism to Filament so components can declare typed injection points and callers can fill them with arbitrary child VNodes. Two restrictions currently in tag_engine.ex must be lifted together: 1. `<:slot_name>` consumer syntax is rejected (lines 520-527) 2. Remote components with inner content (`...`) are rejected (lines 511-518) ## Provider API (defcomponent) ```elixir defcomponent MyLayout do slot :header, required: false, default: MyDefaultHeader slot :inner_block, required: true slot :footer, required: false def render(assigns) do ~F"""
<:header /> <:inner_block /> <:footer default={AltFooter} />
""" end end ``` ## Consumer API ```elixir ~F""" <:header> <:inner_block> """ ``` ## Data Representation Slots are passed as lists of `%Filament.Slot.Entry{render_fn: fn, attrs: map}` in the props map. The VNode type gains a `{:slot, atom(), [Entry.t()], module() | nil}` node that the renderer resolves at walk time. ## Primary Use Case Screen template pattern for octo_pi_tui2: a root layout component declares structural regions (header, body, status bar) that applications fill with component trees. See docs/filament-slots-feature-request.md for full spec including edge cases, fiber identity semantics, and future :for/:let extensibility.
title: Filament: Named Slot Mechanism for ~F Templates
